rationale.conceptual: The method uses established DFT, AIMD, and phonon integration workflow published in many computational materials science studies. Implementing it correctly requires understanding of periodic DFT, statistical mechanics, and phonon calculations, but no novel algorithms or deep domain-specific derivations beyond standard solid-state physics.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises building a 3×3×3 supercell, DFT geometry relaxation, NVT AIMD equilibration at 329 K, quenching to freeze disorder, then finite-displacement phonon calculations (many static DFT runs) and post-processing with Phonopy to obtain thermodynamic functions. This is a 4-5 stage workflow with sequential dependencies, requiring careful tool orchestration and input preparation, typical of a multi-step computational study.
